title.zh: 为当前阿里云账号开通密钥管理服务

descriptions.zh:
- RAM用户或RAM角色调用该OpenAPI需要被授予的权限策略详情，请参见[访问控制](~~2767210~~)。

- 密钥管理服务需要收费，计费详情请参见[计费说明](~~52608~~)。

- 一个阿里云账号只能开通一次。

- 请确保阿里云账号已通过实名认证。
descriptions.en:
- For more information about the access policies that a RAM user or RAM role needs to call this OpenAPI, see [Resource Access Management](~~2767210~~).

- KMS is a paid service. For more information about billing, see [Billing](~~52608~~).

- You can activate the service for an Alibaba Cloud account only once.

- Make sure that your Alibaba Cloud account has completed real-name verification.
